original_goal:
[Module: Checkout - Information | TC-013 | Type: Edge/Input | Priority: Medium]
Title: Very long text in name fields (200+ chars) is accepted or visibly truncated

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-step-one.html
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "user": "standard_user"
}

Preconditions:
  User is on the Checkout – Information form

Steps to Execute:
  1. Enter a 200+ character string in the First Name field
  2. Enter a 200+ character string in the Last Name field
  3. Enter a valid postal code in the Zip/Postal Code field
  4. Click **Continue**

Expected Result:
  Either the form submits successfully and the Overview displays the full long strings; or submission is blocked and the field is visibly truncated with an inline indicator/error; the UI must clearly indicate which behaviour occurred

Notes from prior verification:
  Manually verified for completion.
